title: 第十一章 只对你第十二章 脑子有病吧
slug: 末世大佬穿星际四个竹马悔哭了
content_zh:
回到家的唐斩月心情愉悦地翻了一个多小时星网，吃饭的时候都没关，看见骂温晚意的就点赞，等她回过神来，第三碗饭都吃完了。
唐斩月倒吸一口气，赶紧去训练室练了一个小时。
睡觉前，机甲工程系的课程表发到了她的光脑里。
系内暂定，让她跟大一一起上课，如果跟不上的话，下学期再跟新生从头开始。
后面还附赠了原宽的留言：
应校长要求，你的体质和精神力未进行检测，直接判定达标。我不知道你爸跟校长说了什么，但如果后续课程中发现你无法跟上学习进度，我会毫不留情地开除你。
唐斩月看完忍不住感慨，这老师还挺负责，但现实中不畏强权，又没什么背景的人往往没有好下场。
好在她是个有原则的人，要真跟不上，她也不会勉强自己，大不了从头再来嘛。
洗漱后，唐斩月又逛了会儿星网，然后沉沉睡去。
第二天一早，机器人管家便尽职尽责地过来叫唐斩月起床吃饭，并在她出门前，将整理好的三个行李箱推过去。
——里面装了日用品，床上用品，还有各种场合需要的衣服鞋子饰品等。
唐斩月要开始住宿了，以后没什么事，她应该不会经常回家，所以管家给她收拾了很多东西。
把行李收进空间钮，唐斩月摸了摸机器人圆溜溜的脑袋，“小d，要好好看家哦，我会想你的。”
机器人管家圆圆的眼睛一秒变成泪泡眼，“小主人，小d也会想你的。”
唐斩月忍不住笑，对着它摆摆手。
跟昨天一样，唐斩月还是在校门口下车，并再次引起了学生们的围观，只是目光友善了许多。
刚进入校门，熟悉的橘红色身影便冲到唐斩月脚边，仰头对着她叫：“叽～”声音黏糊糊的还带着点委屈。
唐斩月又惊又喜，“赤璃！”她对着地上的小狐狸张开怀抱。
上次对赤璃发脾气，她事后很愧疚，感觉自己好像提上裤子不认人的渣男，所以再见面态度温柔了不少。
赤璃蹦到她怀里，一个劲儿地蹭着她撒娇。

不远处，穿着墨蓝军装，身姿挺拔的青年大步走来。
“好久不见。”叶峥笑着打招呼，随后自然道：“我带你去宿舍。”
唐斩月不自觉地跟着他走，“你不应该在军部吗？”
叶峥边走边解释：“重伤疗养，暂时从前线退下来。接下来的两个月，我会在军校战斗系任职。”
唐斩月用精神力检查赤璃，神色更加疑惑，“它这不是好的差不多了吗？”
叶峥叹气：“它好的太快了，这不合常理。”他看向她，“除了我，你应该没给别人治疗过吧？”
唐斩月点头，这个世界确实没有。
叶峥松了口气，“你治愈精神体的速度太快了，在弄清楚原因之前，最好不要让其他人知道。”
唐斩月没什么意见，她又不是什么圣母心的人，要不是当初看叶峥长得好看还有用，她压根不会管他。
“有人在拍照。”唐斩月看向不远处僵立的学生，蹙眉不解地问：“她拍我们干什么？”
叶峥轻咳一声：“可能因为，我还挺出名的？”
唐斩月恍然大悟，“对，你是联邦最年轻的少将。”
叶峥矜持地笑了笑，“网友们有些夸大其词了，各大军团优秀的年轻人数不胜数，我只是其中之一。”
content_en:
After returning home, Tang Zhanyue happily browsed the Star Network for more than an hour. She didn't even turn it off when eating. She liked someone who scolded Wen Wanyi. When she came to her senses, she had finished the third bowl of rice.
Tang Zhanyue took a breath and hurried to the training room to practice for an hour.
Before going to bed, the course schedule of the Mecha Engineering Department was sent to her optical brain.
The department has tentatively decided to let her take classes with the freshmen. If she can't keep up, she will start over with the freshmen next semester.
There is also a message from Yuan Kuan at the back:
At the request of the principal, your physical and mental strength were not tested and were directly judged to be up to standard. I don't know what your dad told the principal, but if you find that you can't keep up with your studies in subsequent classes, I will expel you without mercy.
Tang Zhanyue couldn't help but sigh after reading it. This teacher is quite responsible, but in reality, people who are not afraid of power and have no background often do not end well.
Fortunately, she is a principled person. If she really can't keep up, she won't force herself. At worst, she will have to start all over again.
After washing, Tang Zhanyue browsed the Star Network for a while, and then fell asleep.
Early the next morning, the robot butler dutifully came over to wake Tang Zhanyue up for dinner, and pushed the three suitcases she had packed before she went out.
——It contains daily necessities, bedding, as well as clothes, shoes and accessories needed for various occasions.
Tang Zhanyue was about to start staying at the hotel. She wouldn't go home often if she had nothing to do in the future, so the housekeeper packed a lot of things for her.
After putting the luggage into the space button, Tang Zhanyue touched the robot's round head and said, "Little D, take good care of your house. I will miss you."
The round eyes of the robot butler turned into tear-filled eyes in a second, "Little Master, Little D will miss you too."
Tang Zhanyue couldn't help laughing and waved his hand towards it.
Just like yesterday, Tang Zhanyue got off the bus at the school gate and once again attracted the attention of students, but his eyes were much friendlier.
As soon as he entered the school gate, a familiar orange-red figure rushed to Tang Zhanyue's feet, raised his head and shouted at her: "Ji~" The voice was sticky and a little aggrieved.
Tang Zhanyue was surprised and happy, "Chili!" She opened her arms to the little fox on the ground.
The last time she lost her temper with Chili, she felt very guilty afterwards. She felt like a scumbag who had pulled up his pants and refused to recognize anyone, so his attitude was much gentler when they met again.
Chili jumped into her arms and kept rubbing against her like a baby.
Not far away, a young man wearing a dark blue military uniform and standing tall strode forward.
"Long time no see." Ye Zheng greeted with a smile, and then said naturally: "I will take you to the dormitory."
Tang Zhanyue followed him unconsciously, "Shouldn't you be in the military headquarters?"
Ye Zheng explained as he walked: "I am recovering from serious injuries and will temporarily withdraw from the front line. In the next two months, I will work in the combat department of the military academy."
Tang Zhanyue used his mental power to examine Chili, his expression even more confused, "Isn't it almost good?"
Ye Zheng sighed: "It healed too quickly, which is unreasonable." He looked at her, "Besides me, you have never treated anyone else, right?"
Tang Zhanyue nodded, there was indeed no such thing in this world.
Ye Zheng breathed a sigh of relief, "You heal your mental body too quickly. It's best not to let others know before you figure out the reason."
Tang Zhanyue didn't have any objections. She was not a person with a holy mother's heart. If she hadn't thought Ye Zheng was good-looking and useful, she wouldn't have cared about him at all.
"Someone is taking pictures." Tang Zhanyue looked at the students standing frozen not far away, frowned and asked, "Why is she taking pictures of us?"
Ye Zheng coughed lightly: "Maybe because I'm quite famous?"
Tang Zhanyue suddenly realized, "Yes, you are the youngest major general in the Federation."
Ye Zheng smiled reservedly, "Netizens are exaggerating a bit. There are countless outstanding young people in the major legions, and I am just one of them."
